Graduate Programs
Graduate Programs
Take your expertise further with graduate study in Electrical and Computer Engineering at UNC Charlotte. Through M.S. and Ph.D. programs, you’ll dive into advanced topics like artificial intelligence, robotics, communications, computer systems, microelectronics and power and energy systems, while working alongside faculty driving innovation in these fields. With access to state-of-the-art labs and hands-on research opportunities, you’ll tackle real-world engineering challenges and build the depth of knowledge needed to lead in industry, research or academia.

Culminating Experience
Tackle real engineering challenges, build specialized expertise and showcase your skills through a thesis, faculty-guided project or comprehensive exam.
Discover Your Project Path
Graduate Assistantships
Gain hands-on experience while supporting your graduate education. Assistantships offer opportunities to work with faculty on teaching and research projects while providing tuition support and professional development in your field.
Explore Assistantships
Tuition Support
Graduate students at UNC Charlotte can access tuition support through assistantships and Graduate School funding programs. These opportunities help reduce the cost of study while providing hands-on experience in teaching and research, making graduate education more affordable and impactful.
